name: Stone Golem
damageImmunities: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the language of its creator

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

actions.name: Force Bolt
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Force damage. Bonus Actions Slow (Recharge 5–6). The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). Storm Giant Storm Giant
